specs.name: asic_low_area
specs.description: Motor-control sin/cos in sky130 standard cells: >= 1 MSPS, max error <= 2^-10. Area is everything: minimise cell area.

specs.name: asic_power_50msps
specs.description: A 50 MSPS sin/cos unit in sky130 standard cells for a battery-powered radio: max error <= 2^-12. Minimise the relative power index; accuracy is the trade-off.

specs.name: asic_multiaxis_control
specs.description: Shared sin/cos unit in sky130 standard cells for a 16-axis motor-control loop: a 1 MHz control tick issues 32 requests at once; all 32 results must be back within 0.5 us of the tick (p99 over ticks). Max error <= 2^-12. Minimise area.
